authority: Owner authorized an explicit 1776 gap and neutral physical land until eligible historical geometry is sourced and separately reviewed. This record documents source blockers; it is not an approval of geometry.
reason: No eligible 1776 boundary geometry exists. The National Archives Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776) asserts independence of the thirteen united States but supplies no coordinate polygons and does not establish agreed boundaries or effective control. Historical Basemaps has no 1776 entry; its 1715 and 1783 snapshots cannot be backcast, and 1783 is excluded by a demonstrated Jacksonville ownership error. 1776 therefore remains a visible gap with neutral physical land. Neither the Declaration, 1715 nor 1783 may be presented as an effective-control boundary for 1776.
transformation: None. No geometry is imported, digitized, interpolated or backcast for 1776. Neutral physical land from Natural Earth remains the only rendered context.
conflicts: No licensed primary historical geometry or defensible historical-map digitization has been identified for a bounded 1776 state.
